import hopsworks
import pandas as pd

proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

df = pd.read_csv("data/reload/new_export.csv", dtype={"row_id": str, "full_name": str, "currency": str})
df["updated_at"] = df["updated_at"].astype("int64")
df["balance"] = df["balance"].astype("float64")
print("V2 shape:", df.shape, "cols:", list(df.columns))
print(df.dtypes)

fg2 = fs.create_feature_group(
    name="customersa8deb9",
    version=2,
    description="Customers full re-export (new breaking schema)",
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    event_time="updated_at",
    online_enabled=True,
)
fg2.insert(df, write_options={"wait_for_job": True})
print("V2 inserted")

import hopsworks

proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

fg2 = fs.get_feature_group("customersa8deb9", version=2)
print("online_enabled:", fg2.online_enabled)
print("cols:", [f.name for f in fg2.features])

off = fg2.read()
print("OFFLINE rows:", len(off), "cols:", list(off.columns))

# online lookup test
import pandas as pd
sample = off["row_id"].head(3).tolist()
fv = None
for rid in sample:
    try:
        row = fg2.read(online=True) if False else None
    except Exception as e:
        print("err", e)
# online single-vector via feature view-less: use fg.find or online read
try:
    on = fg2.read(online=True)
    print("ONLINE rows:", len(on))
except Exception as e:
    print("online read err:", repr(e))
